questions.q: What is infrastructure as code?
questions.basic: Infrastructure as code expresses infrastructure resources in version-controlled configuration so teams can review, reproduce, and automate environments.
questions.strong: Infrastructure as code expresses infrastructure resources in version-controlled configuration so teams can review, reproduce, and automate environments. questions.q: Docker image versus container?
questions.basic: An image is the packaged, layered filesystem and configuration from which containers are created.
questions.strong: An image is the packaged, layered filesystem and configuration from which containers are created. A container is an isolated process instance with runtime state and resource constraints. Images improve repeatability, but containers still share the host kernel and require appropriate security configuration.
questions.takeaway: Images improve repeatability, but containers still share the host kernel and require appropriate security configuration.

questions.q: What does an orchestration platform such as Kubernetes provide?
questions.basic: It schedules workloads onto cluster nodes, maintains desired replicas, exposes services, and supports rolling updates, health checks, and resource constraints.
questions.strong: It schedules workloads onto cluster nodes, maintains desired replicas, exposes services, and supports rolling updates, health checks, and resource constraints. It does not automatically fix application-level failures or poor database design. Start with clear operational needs before adding orchestration complexity.
questions.takeaway: Start with clear operational needs before adding orchestration complexity.

questions.q: What is a rolling deployment?
questions.basic: A rolling deployment gradually replaces old instances with new ones while retaining capacity for serving traffic.

questions.q: Explain blue-green deployment.
questions.basic: Maintain two production-like environments, with only one receiving normal traffic.

questions.q: What is a canary release?

questions.q: How do you debug a container that restarts repeatedly?
